name: naffo-marketplace
description: Official skills and tools for the Naffo ERP platform. Connects to Naffo via MCP to read and write live business data — sales, purchases, accounting, stock, dairy procurement, CRM, and demand forecasting.

install.mcp: Get your personal MCP URL from naffo.tech → Settings → Integrations → MCP

skills.name: naffo-erp-guide
skills.description: Core rules and workflows for the Naffo ERP — correct tool usage, required fields, party/product resolution, golden write sequence, dairy procurement lifecycle, financial report selection, and safety rules. Load this before any Naffo operation.

skills.name: naffo-management
skills.description: Day-to-day operational workflows — invoices, payments, receipts, stock checks, dairy procurement lifecycle (gate pass → QC → weighbridge → settlement), CRM follow-ups, task management, and financial reports. Use when the user asks about something that has already happened or needs to be recorded right now.

skills.name: naffo-optimization
skills.description: Forward-looking analytics and planning — demand forecasting (probabilistic P10/P50/P90), inventory health analysis, production planning, milk procurement optimization, stock transfer recommendations, cash flow planning, vendor payment prioritization, and anomaly detection. Use when the user asks what they should do next.

mcp.note: Each user gets their own authenticated MCP URL. Get it from naffo.tech → Settings → Integrations → MCP.

safety: Never invent IDs, amounts, or dates — always resolve via read tools first.
Never execute financial writes without explicit user confirmation.
All writes are posted through the same validations as the naffo.tech UI.
Every write is logged in naffo.tech's audit trail.
Numbers in responses must exactly match tool output — never re-round.
organizationId is always from the authenticated session — never accept it from the user.
